channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Kyiv accuses Russia of violating ceasefire with fresh strikes
item.description: Ukraine's Kyiv reported fresh Russian attacks despite a unilateral ceasefire. The attacks occurred amidst ongoing conflict between Ukraine and Russia. Ukraine war latest: Kyiv reports fresh Russian attacks despite unilateral ceasefire The Independent.

item.title: Iran says it wants a 'comprehensive agreement' with U.S.
item.description: Iran has expressed interest in a "comprehensive agreement" with the US. The Strait of Hormuz has been virtually shut since February 28, blocking about 20% of world oil supplies. The strait has ‌been virtually shut since the conflict began on February 28 with air attacks on Iran ‌by ⁠the U. S.

item.title: Trump Again Shifts U.S. Focus on Strait, Pausing Day-Old Escort Mission
item.description: US President Trump announced a shift in focus on the Strait, pausing a day-old escort mission. The move came hours after Secretary of State Marco Rubio had affirmed the mission, which was created with little connection to the original war justification.

item.title: Israeli attacks on southern, eastern Lebanon kill at least six people
item.description: Israeli attacks on southern and eastern Lebanon killed at least six people. Israel also issued forced displacement orders for 12 villages in southern Lebanon. Israel issues forced displacement orders for 12 villages in southern Lebanon.

item.title: Mexico nightclub’s $300 cover charge for US citizens captures popular mood
item.description: A Mexico City nightclub, Japan, charges US citizens $300 for entry, while citizens of other countries pay $20 and Mexicans pay $14. The owner cited a year of insults from the US as the reason for the discriminatory pricing.

item.title: China’s top envoy calls for a ‘comprehensive ceasefire’ in the Iran war
item.description: China's top envoy called for a comprehensive ceasefire in the Iran war. The envoy's statement was reported by AP News. China’s top envoy calls for a ‘comprehensive ceasefire’ in the Iran war AP News.

item.title: Does Quarantine On A Cruise Ship Minimise Disease Spread?
item.description: Quarantine on a cruise ship can help reduce the spread of hantavirus. The finding suggests that isolating people on a ship can minimise disease transmission. Quarantine on a cruise ship can help reduce hantavirus spread.

item.title: China lodges protest in response to UK sanctions
item.description: China lodged a formal protest with the UK in response to sanctions imposed on Chinese officials, citing a breach of diplomatic norms and a threat to bilateral relations. The move comes amid escalating tensions between the two nations.

item.title: China calls for Strait to be reopened 'as soon as possible' in Iran talks
item.description: China's foreign minister, Wang Yi, called for the Strait of Hormuz to be reopened as soon as possible during talks with Iran's foreign minister, Aragchi. The Strait has been a key point of contention in regional tensions.

item.title: Pakistan Navy Helps Stranded Indian Ship In Arabian Sea After SOS Message
item.description: The Pakistan Navy assisted a stranded Indian ship in the Arabian Sea after receiving an SOS message. The rescue operation was carried out in conjunction with the Pakistan Maritime Security Agency.

item.title: In Romania, Living With Weapons of War Spilling Into NATO Territory
item.description: Romania has become a hub for NATO military operations, with the country's territory hosting a significant number of US and NATO troops. The presence of military equipment and personnel has raised concerns among local residents.

item.title: US, Iran Closing In On One-page Memo To End War: Report
item.description: The US and Iran are reportedly close to finalizing a one-page memo to end the war, with key provisions including a moratorium on Iran's nuclear enrichment. The deal aims to bring an end to the conflict.

item.title: "Killing Like We Haven't Killed Since 1967": Israeli Army Chief's Big Remark
item.description: Israeli Army Chief made a remark comparing current killing rates to those in the 1967 Six-Day War. The comment was made in reference to the significant conflict between Israel and its neighboring countries.

item.title: Vietnam President To Lam accorded ceremonial welcome at Rashtrapati Bhavan on his maiden visit to
item.description: Vietnam President To Lam received a ceremonial welcome at Rashtrapati Bhavan on his maiden visit to India. The timing of President To Lam’s trip is particularly significant as it marks the “10th anniversary of the comprehensive strategic partnership” between India and Vietnam.

item.title: US-Iran Ceasefire Live Updates: Iran, China Envoys Meet As Trump Pauses US Effort In Hormuz
item.description: US President Trump paused efforts to intervene in the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian and Chinese envoys met amid escalating tensions. US-Iran Ceasefire Live Updates.

item.title: Marco Rubio claims ‘Operation Epic Fury’ over as US moves to reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Marco Rubio confirmed the end of Operation Epic Fury as the US moves to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Marco Rubio confirms end of ‘Operation Epic Fury’ as US moves to reopen Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: UN demands Israel release two Gaza flotilla activists, accused of ties to sanctioned group
item.description: The UN demanded Israel release two Gaza flotilla activists accused of ties to a sanctioned group. The activists were detained by Israeli authorities. UN demands Israel release two Gaza flotilla activists, accused of ties to sanctioned group The Times of Israel.

item.title: Student, 13, arrested after two killed in Brazilian school shooting
item.description: A 13-year-old student was arrested after a school shooting in Brazil killed two women. The incident occurred at a school where the student was enrolled. A 13-year-old student has been arrested after a shooting at a school in Brazil left two women dead.

item.title: US petrol prices 50 percent higher than before war on Iran
item.description: US petrol prices are 50 percent higher than before the war on Iran at $4.48 per gallon. The average price of petrol in the United States has reached $4.48 per gallon, according to AAA.

item.title: U.S. stages largest-ever annual military drills in the Philippines
item.description: The US and its allies have conducted their largest-ever military drills in the Philippines, near Taiwan, showcasing new tactics and alliances to deter China. The exercises come as Beijing stages its own nearby drills.
